info.title: Airudit.MdBook – Usage
info.description: turns a collection of markdown files into a book

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: This command will generate HTML files for each specified markdown file.

options.name: --Export
options.description: Copy the generated pages into <dir> (mirrored paths)

options.name: --Single-File
options.description: Combine every page into one self-contained HTML file

options.name: --Side
options.description:
Also write the in-place files. They are on by default but
suppressed once --Export or --Single-File is given; pass
--Side to keep writing them as well.
